about: Per-game recipes for gbox.evidence_capture (docs/pr-evidence.md): how a test session reaches a frame that shows the replaced characters. moment = a saved state (kind artifact: a state_transfer export digest, portable between nodes of the same emulator core; kind slot: a save slot on the node that saved it; kind mod_card: the saved moment a mod card links). A state holds the models that were in RAM when it was saved, so after_moment are the inputs that make the game load them again from the modded disc (a restart, a Continue, a scene change). steps = the boot path when there is no moment. Pad names: a b x y start select up down left right l r z (gBox pad; RetroArch maps them to the system's pad). status: ready (seen working) | unverified (written from the game's menus and the saved frames, not yet replayed) | needs_state (the operator must record a moment: todo says how) | todo. A moment recorded with POST /api/evidence/moments replaces the seed moment.

c747331797369f74.title: SoulCalibur (USA) (Dreamcast)
c747331797369f74.shows: Arcade mode, player 1 (Kilik, where the cursor starts) against the CPU: the versus screen shows the stock 2D portraits, the fight from about 9 s shows both replaced fighters. VS BATTLE needs a 2P start, which the player-1 network pad cannot give. Menu presses through the network pad register twice (the main menu drum moves two items per press), so the recipe only uses Start and A.
